rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_constrained.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.7, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-2 fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained breast (search-20260703-01), val_n=200. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) PRIOR: iter-1 (dc_relax0.5, init_t0.7, steps8, eta1.0) -> SSIM 0.7220, PSNR 27.35, RMSE 1.465e-2, hr 0.0000, elapsed 121s. Breast LD-FBP calibrated baseline_PSNR ~36.3 (baseline is a STRONG sparse-view FBP after calibration); the Mayo-trained wavelet prior (fd_out_scale=0.05) is ~10x mis-normalised vs breast mu~0.5, so at dc_relax=0.5 only HALF the CG-projected (data-consistent) image is blended in and the mis-scaled prior half drags PSNR ~9 dB below baseline -> hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: prior-domain-normalisation mismatch corrupts HU faster than the PARTIAL (relax0.5) DC pulls it back; the DC-strength axis is under-applied. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_dc_relax 0.5 -> 1.0 (FULL hard-CG DC projection each Euler step; blend the CG-fit image 100%, discard the mis-scaled prior's HU offset). ALL else identical to iter-1 (steps8, init_t0.7, eta1.0, dc1, n_cg5). This is the proven Mayo-constrained RMSE-down direction (its iter-2->3 dc_relax0.5->1.0 lowered RMSE). (4) HYPOTHESIS: dc_relax 0.5->1.0 lifts PSNR toward the FBP baseline and cuts RMSE below 1.465e-2 because full DC anchors every slice to its measured 128-view sinogram, neutralising the 10x out_scale prior mismatch; hr may still be 0 (a Mayo-prior on breast is FBP-bounded) but RMSE must drop meaningfully. FALSIFIER: if RMSE >= 1.465e-2 (dc_relax INERT or worse), full DC is already saturated at relax0.5 -> iter-3 pivots to fd_recon_init_t lower (0.7->0.4, start reverse-diffusion closer to FBP so the mis-scaled prior has fewer steps to drift HU). (5) BUDGET: dc_relax is FREE (same 8 steps + CG5); iter-1 ran 121s << 1200s budget / 1800s kill. val=ALL 200 seed-20260703 cases. (6) Loop continues; iter-3 self-dispatched on landing via the numeric-RMSE gate.
